tagline: Earlier, clearer information for food-security decisions

welcome.title: Plan ahead with agricultural and market information
welcome.intro: This platform links weather, soil, production and market information to help analysts, citizens, retailers and farmers make earlier, better-informed decisions.
welcome.disclaimer: Outlooks are estimates that support decisions. They are not guarantees or policy advice.

market.title: Market prices
market.intro: Monthly average prices across monitored markets. Observed history and any validated forecast are shown separately.
market.trendHelp: Compares the last 3 months with the 3 months before. Needs at least 6 months of observed prices.
market.chartCaption: Solid line: observed monthly average. Dashed line: validated forecast, if available. Shaded band: forecast range.
market.chartAria: Line chart of monthly average prices with observed history and forecast
market.noForecast: No validated forecast is available for this crop yet. The chart shows observed prices only.
market.uncertainty: Prices change with weather, harvests and transport. Treat any outlook as an estimate with a range, not a guaranteed price.
market.influenceNone: Linked supply and weather evidence for this crop is not yet connected, so no influences are shown.
market.noData: No approved price data is available for this crop yet.
market.insufficient: Not enough months of observed prices to describe a trend.
market.sampleNotice: Some values on this page are sample data for demonstration. They are not official prices.

national.title: National food-security outlook
national.intro: District market-price signals for each crop, with the source, date and evidence behind every signal. Districts without approved data show as unavailable rather than being guessed.
national.scopeNote: This is a market-price signal only. Weather, soil and production signals are not yet connected, so they are not shown.
national.tableCaption: Districts and their current market signal
national.ruleTitle: How the market signal is calculated
national.ruleText: The average price of the last 3 observed months is compared with the 3 observed months before. A rise of 10% or more is moderate; a rise of 20% or more is high. Any other change is low. The rule looks at the last 9 calendar months. A district needs at least 6 observed months in that window, and its latest price must be no more than 4 months old. Older data never produces a signal.

evidence.title: District evidence
evidence.select: Choose a district in the table to see the evidence behind its signal.
evidence.noSignal: No market signal for this district and crop yet. There is not enough approved price history.
evidence.riseText: The average price over the last 3 months is {percent} above the 3 months before.
evidence.fallText: The average price over the last 3 months is {percent} below the 3 months before.
evidence.flatText: The average price over the last 3 months is about the same as the 3 months before.
evidence.uncertainty: This signal describes market prices only. It is not a forecast of production or a guarantee of future prices.
evidence.responseNote: No response is suggested automatically. Any response needs review by an expert before it is shared.

guidance.title: General guidance
guidance.note: General information only. Expert review is needed before acting on any advice.
guidance.high: Market prices for this crop have risen sharply in your district recently. Compare prices from more than one buyer before selling or buying in bulk.
guidance.moderate: Market prices for this crop have risen recently in your district. Check local prices regularly and plan sales with current information.
guidance.low: Market prices for this crop are stable or falling in your district. There is no market price alert right now.
guidance.unavailable: There is not enough approved price history for your district yet. Ask your local extension office for current information.
guidance.livestock: Weather, feed and milk information for dairy cattle is not yet connected. For feed, water and animal health, ask your local veterinary or extension officer.

action.title: Action Recommendation
action.subtitle: Clear market decision based on current price changes
action.sellAdvice: Market prices in your district are rising strongly (+{percent}). This is an advantageous window for farmers to sell and lock in higher returns.
action.storeSub: Market dip: avoid selling at a loss
action.storeAdvice: Market prices are falling ({percent}). If you have proper dry and ventilated storage, store your crop and wait for prices to stabilize.
action.monitorAdvice: Prices are currently stable (slight change of {percent}). Continue standard harvesting and regular marketing without rushing.
action.consultAdvice: Sufficient approved market price history is not yet recorded for this commodity in your district. Contact your local sector agronomist for guidance.

howToRead.title: How to read this table
howToRead.body: Price columns come from approved district prices. Supply and sourcing columns stay marked unavailable until approved production data is connected. Surplus or shortage labels are not shown, because the data does not yet support them. Routes are not optimised, because logistics data is not available.

alerts.title: Alerts and simulator
alerts.intro: Alerts tell farmers, extension workers and analysts when something needs attention. Right now every alert here is a simulation for demonstration. Nothing is sent to any phone.
alerts.empty: No alerts yet. Run the simulator below to see how an alert is produced.

simulation.title: Simulate a data update
simulation.description: Adds a clearly labelled sample price correction for one district and crop, then shows each step: update received, validation, signal preview and draft alert.
simulation.guarantee: Public pages do not change. The update stays pending until it is reviewed and approved, and no message is sent.
simulation.none: No simulation has been run yet.
simulation.notSent: Simulated alert. Not sent to anyone.

details.validatedPending: Passed checks. Waiting for review, so it is not used in public outputs.
details.validationFailed: Failed checks. The update was rejected and nothing else was created.
details.previewed: Market signal would change from {before} to {after} (change {beforePct} to {afterPct}). Shown as a preview only.
details.drafted: Alert {id} created as a simulation. It cannot be published.

simulation.alertTemplate: [SIMULATED] {district} · {crop}: market signal would change from {before} to {after} if the update is approved. Not sent to anyone.
simulation.explanationTemplate: Simulation {id}: a simulated price correction on the latest month. Public signals stay unchanged until the update is reviewed and approved.
simulation.sourceNote: Simulated data. Not official statistics. Not sent.

methodology.title: Data sources and methodology
methodology.intro: Where every number on this platform comes from, how it is produced, how accurate it has been, and what it cannot yet tell you.
methodology.sourcesNote: Each source is listed with its verification status. A source is only used in public outputs once it is verified or approved for demonstration.
methodology.lineageNote: Each import is a file or feed that was registered, checked and reviewed before its values could appear. Checksums identify the exact file used.
methodology.noImports: No imports have been recorded yet. Load the sample data to see the import history.

forecast.title: Price outlook
forecast.outputValue: Monthly national average price with a range
forecast.horizonValue: Up to 6 months ahead, only from the last approved month
forecast.intervalValue: About 80%, from the method's own errors on past data
forecast.note: A baseline, not a claim of predictive skill. Accuracy is reported only from real backtests below.

risk.title: District market signal
risk.note: Covers market prices only. Weather, soil and production signals are not yet connected.

methodology.accuracyNote: Errors come from re-running the method on past months, using only data available at each point. Lower is better. No accuracy figure is shown unless a backtest produced it.
methodology.noEvaluations: No backtest results are recorded yet. Run the forecast pipeline to produce them.
limits: Only sample price data is loaded so far. No official NISR, MINAGRI or Meteo Rwanda dataset is connected, so no figure should be read as official.
The outlook is a national average across monitored markets. It does not describe any single district.
Market signals describe prices only. They do not measure weather, soil, production or livestock conditions.
Forecast ranges are based on a short history and can be wide. They are not guarantees.
Advisory guidance is general information. Fertilizer doses and veterinary treatment are out of scope and need expert review.
Kinyarwanda text is a draft until a fluent speaker has reviewed it.
